Name: Show Daily Luck
Author: arphox
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b]
[/size]
A tiny mod that does the followings:

When a day starts (or you load a saved game), 1 second after waking up you see a message in the chat box telling you your daily luck as it would be shown in the TV.

[i]Only works if you have a TV.

[/i][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b]
[/size]
Multiplayer: [b]works[/b] independently from multiplayer, so every player has to install it for themselves.
